# Space — Ruang Kerja HIMASIF

> Workspace app of HIMASIF (Information Systems student association, Universitas Jember), 2025/2026 board. Tasks with one owner and a deadline, meetings, shared notes, personal reminders, a Windows desktop app with Ace Island notifications and auto-update, a web app, and a rule-based WhatsApp bot. Go API server + PostgreSQL, one MyGo native UI client compiled for Windows and WebAssembly, and a Node WhatsApp bridge. Pilot, pre-1.0. UI and most docs in Indonesian; AGENTS.md in English. MIT license.

Lead developer: Ahimsa Jenar Bramsaifstyo Kusuma (Tiyoouw, https://tiyoouw.com, GitHub @Tiyouw). Project by HIMASIF ASTRA 25/26.
